title: The closed-lift indexing category is filtered
statement:
The category $\mathcal N_A(\overline C)$ of [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift]
is filtered.

proof.text: An etale A-algebra B has a finite polynomial-quotient presentation by Algebra.FinitePresentation.iff. Transport etaleness and a specified map B -> C across the presentation isomorphism. This is the private helper exists_index, and will be applied to every successor constructed below. Applying it to B=A and the structural map A -> C proves nonemptiness, including zero rings.

For X,Y take B=X.alg tensor_A Y.alg with map productMap X.toC Y.toC. Algebra.Etale.baseChange followed by Algebra.Etale.comp gives Etale A B. Choose its presentation using exists_index. Conjugating includeLeft and includeRight by the inverse presentation isomorphism gives compatible arrows from X and Y to this object.

For parallel f,g:X -> Y put h=productMap f.hom g.hom, K=ker(lmul:X.alg tensor_A X.alg -> X.alg), and J=K.map h. Etaleness makes Omega[X.alg/A] zero. Its identification with K/K^2 and Ideal.cotangent_subsingleton_iff give K*K=K; Ideal.map_mul gives J*J=J. KaehlerDifferential.ideal_fg and finite generation of ideal images give J.FG. These are the direct Mathlib calculations hK, hJ and hJfg.

Set Q=Y.alg/J. Algebra.FinitePresentation.quotient gives finite presentation over Y.alg. Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_of_surjective identifies formal etaleness of the quotient map with idempotence of its kernel, which is J by Ideal.mk_ker. Thus Q is etale over Y.alg, and Algebra.Etale.comp gives etaleness over A. This is the ring calculation of the diagonal pullback in the original proof.

Compatibility of f and g gives Y.toC.comp h = X.toC.comp lmul, checked on both tensor inclusions. Hence Y.toC kills J and descends to q:Q -> C by Ideal.Quotient.lift_a (liftₐ in Lean). For every x the tensor x tensor 1 - 1 tensor x lies in K, so f(x)-g(x) lies in J. The quotient therefore equalizes f and g. Apply exists_index to Q and conjugate the quotient map to obtain a compatible arrow Y -> Z in the literal small model. Extensionality of Index.Hom proves the required equality of composites. Together with nonemptiness and common successors these are the fields of IsFiltered.
